note: Both sets contain the same six claims with the same values, units, conditions and supporting quotes: max positive pitch 4° in Region 1.5, design point TSR 9.0 / pitch 0°, optimal TSR 8.5 / pitch −1.0°, and force peak near 90 m at below-rated wind speeds. All values are correctly bound to the blade and match the text layer and page image. The only difference is cosmetic: Set B keeps the Θpitch symbol in two attribute names, which is marginally more precise but not a substantive improvement. Neither set contains any wrong, invented or unsupported claim.
remarks: Both sets omit other quantitative facts on the page (e.g., the sharp linear force drop over the outboard 5% of the blade from the Prandtl tip loss model, and the effectively negligible Region 2.5), but since the sets are identical in content this does not differentiate them. Note the text says the design point is 'slightly below the optimal' while the optimal values are read off the CP/CT curves in Figure 3-2; both sets' 'maximum CP' condition is a reasonable but slightly interpretive gloss.
